dataset.description: Synthetic duplicate-delivery and expired-lease workload for the Day 5 durable job subsystem.

environment.database: temporary SQLite; PostgreSQL concurrency is tested separately

interpretation_limits: This is a synthetic reliability experiment, not production business revenue.
Latency is local-machine evidence and must not be generalized to production.
The baseline intentionally represents an at-least-once consumer without an idempotent database claim.
